question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 4: to cry".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The usage of the verb in the infinitive form **"to cry" **is appropriate in this context as it denotes an action that the subject (Munoo) began or commenced.
 
• **"Begins to"** is a common phrase used to indicate the start of an action, thus forming a sentence that is meaningful and grammatically correct.
 
• This matches the rest of the verbs used in the following sentences which are in the past tense, making the story internally consistent.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is *"Option 4: to cry".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Cry"** and **"cried" **would result in a sentence that is grammatically incorrect as they do not fit correctly after "began"
 
• **"Having cried"** introduces an action that was completed prior to the time of the main verb ("began") and would potentially change the intended meaning of the sentence by implying that Munoo had already finished crying at the time he was beginning something.
